How should I organise watering schedules?

Use a schedule to remember to inspect each plant. Check moisture and drainage, consider growing conditions and species-specific guidance, and decide whether watering is appropriate.

Room for changing conditions

Temperature, light, season, potting mix and container size can affect watering needs. Review intervals as conditions change.

The FloraTend approach

The planned care workflow records completed actions and offers check dates, snoozing and paused schedules. Dates are reminders, not guaranteed watering instructions.
